title: EX-03 — useful task, sealed submission, oracle and the bounded cap edit
fixture_label: offline scripted-lane legs + the pinned actual-execution packet (hh-s1-useful/1, R5.43); scratch store is not a sandbox; live/provider legs remain owed to ADR-0363

prerequisites.companion: the actual S1 execution evidence is the pinned R5.43 packet; the card verifies it and drives the deterministic legs — prerecorded inspection is not execution

negative_controls: stale pin — a drifted card sha256 or edited packet refuses stale_pin before any execution
absent/fake event — a packet leg outside the closed set, an untyped verdict, a missing seal or a mutated disposition fails packet/sealed_submission
wrong semantic output — the unchanged oracle maps the wrong candidate to C (task fail), never a pass
unsupported edit/recovery — a malformed cap kind is refused typed at open_session (edit_refusal records the verbatim error)
missing recipient bytes — an incomplete or tampered export fails the receipt completeness leg

costs.build: one cargo build/test of hharness + deps (minutes, existing toolchain); no added dependencies
costs.runtime: seconds; two scripted-lane runs (baseline + edited cap) + one export/recipient store; no network, no provider, $0

limitations: the packet leg verifies the retained hh-s1-useful/1 record verbatim — live useful-task execution stays gated (disposition/carried_predicates honest, never relabelled)
the field-edit leg proves the cap is consumed and enforced (budget_id joins the node's content address) — adaptation, not a causal-efficacy claim
the oracle legs are the deterministic oracle boundary — no provider, judge or human oracle executes
fixture/scratch posture — never S1/S3, useful-task, live or study evidence
